name: FlashStudy
description: A polished mobile-first flashcard application with flip animations and progress tracking.
prompt: Build me a polished mobile-first flashcard study application. Users should be able to create flashcards with a question and answer, edit cards, delete cards, study cards one at a time, reveal the answer, and mark each card as known or needs review. Show study progress during a session. Persist flashcards and study results in localStorage. Use a dark modern mobile-first interface with a card-flip style interaction. Use only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.
